_comment: Expected slug lists for renderTemplate(industry, size). Generated from the 11 SoT JSON files under ../../data/ by the algorithm in render.ts. Snapshot is the contract — if a JSON changes, the diff lands here and a human reviews. After §30 B2.1 SoT patches (operations/salesperson broadened to A; pack-mfg/pack-retail added priority operations + pack-mfg replaced core mkt/sales with size-targeted versions; pack-government adds HR + skips operations; pack-research broadened chief-scientist to C + renamed lab-manager corp to 'Head of Lab Operations'; pack-it-software engineer dropped at C) and §30 P2-6 (pack-research now defines its own cto + hr-research roles, drops marketer/salesperson via coreOverrides at all sizes, narrows lab-manager to B/C only — Research-D now set-matches §A exactly), 22 of 24 cells now match §A appendix as sets. Residual divergences (IT-D + Retail-D Option Y supersets) documented in render.test.ts KNOWN_A_APPENDIX_DELTAS.
